name: Santa Claus
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid adopting the customs and philosophies of the world that are contrary to Christ, as seen in Colossians 2:8 and Romans 12:2. The Lord commands His people not to learn from the ways of the heathen (Jeremiah 10:2) and emphasizes truthfulness, condemning lying as an abomination (Proverbs 12:22; Colossians 3:9). In recognizing God’s supremacy over man (Job 33:12), Christians are called to discern and reject traditions, such as the figure of Santa Claus, that may distract from the gospel and foster deception rather than godly transformation.
